name: The Broodmother
summary: At Gloomrise, the Earthen Ring asks you to stop the spider infestation by confronting its broodmother. The threat puts the people of Mulgore at risk.

sections.title: The Gloomrise Nest
sections.body: The Earthen Ring believes a powerful matriarch is driving the spider infestation at Gloomrise. You are asked to seek out Broodmother Valraxx and destroy her. The spiders seem unlike ordinary spiders, so the Ring warns you to be ready for anything.

sections.title: Troubling Signs
sections.body: Afterward, the Earthen Ring reports reanimated dead and a broodmother with a night elven form. These discoveries trouble them, though they set aside the question of what they mean. They thank you for helping the Ring and Mulgore's people.

faq.answer: A spider infestation is spreading at Gloomrise, and the Earthen Ring believes a powerful matriarch is leading it.
Broodmother Valraxx is the broodmother at Gloomrise whom the Earthen Ring asks you to destroy.

faq.q: Why does the Earthen Ring want the broodmother gone?
faq.answer: The Ring believes the broodmother is driving the hostile spider population to spread.

faq.q: What does the Earthen Ring say about these spiders?
faq.answer: The Earthen Ring says these seem to be no ordinary spiders.
